title: One-pager: pilot smoke contacts ledger
content:
Purpose:
Lightweight register for ad-hoc pilots / smoke runs that need a single-page contact + capacity + quick-cost estimate. Use for weekend coverage handoffs and single-toggle rollbacks. Keep terse — this is a shallow spreadsheet substitute.

Quick table (rows = pilots):
Pilot name | Owner | Primary contact (email/Slack) | Region | Est. GPU-hours (first 72h) | Cost est (USD) | Risk tier (L/M/H) | Weekend coverage required? | Current blocker / notes
Smoke-CheapChat-1 | Maya Chen | maya@redwood.ai / #eng-maya | us-west1 | 18 | 220 | M | Yes (Sat night) | Need quantized 4-bit image, infra PR RW-421 pending
Pilot-EmbedTune-Beta | Marco Silva | marco@redwood.ai / #ml-marco | eu-west1 | 10 | 120 | L | No | Waiting on allowlist for customer org
Toggle-SearchAssist-A | Ethan Kim | ethan@redwood.ai / #platform-ethan | us-east4 | 36 | 440 | H | Yes (Sun morning) | Canary route not created; SLO owners TBD
Small-Rerank-AB | Lena Ortiz | lena@redwood.ai / #prod-lena | ap-southeast1 | 8 | 95 | M | Maybe | Data privacy checklist incomplete

Open questions (to resolve before weekend):
- Who is primary pager for each pilot? (we have contacts but not paging ops). Action: assign pager in this file.
- Do any pilots require private deployment creds or KMS access? If yes, add security contact.
- Confirm fallback models to use on capacity pressure (quantized fallback, region fallback).

Immediate tasks (owner / ETA):
- Marco: push infra PR RW-421 to green and add canary route (ETA: 2029-06-13)
- Ethan: draft weekend rotation note to SRE (ETA: 2029-06-12 18:00 PT)
- Priya: produce short one-pager for customer success with cost burn estimate (ETA: 2029-06-13)

Mini-cost assumptions (notes):
- GPU-hour estimate uses committed rate table (internal rate 12 USD/GPU-hr for V100-equivalent in hosted). Add +15% buffer for cold cache.
- Cost est includes simple inference token usage + GPU time; does not include data egress (TBD per region).

Hand-off checklist (tick boxes):
- [ ] Pager assigned
- [ ] Canary route created / tested with 1% traffic
- [ ] Fallback model pinned and validated
- [ ] Customer success notified (if pilot involves a customer)
- [ ] Cost estimate sign-off by finance (if > $500)

Notes-to-self / scratch:
- If Toggle-SearchAssist-A goes high error, plan fallback to open-llm-compact. Quick test script at: /scripts/quick-fallback-check.sh
- For weekend cover, ask SRE for 1 extra headcount on Sat 02:00-08:00 UTC if Pilot uses >24 GPU-hrs in 24h window.

Links & refs:
- Confluence: mini-pilot-rollouts (see checklist section)
- Jira: RW-7543 (pilot kickoff EPIC), RW-7547 (canary route), RW-7550 (pager assignment)
- Slack: #pilot-ops, #platform-oncall

Unresolved / nice-to-have columns for next pass:
- SLA/expected latency 
- Acceptance test PR (link)
- Customer success playbook ID

Status notes: draft — sharing with SRE + finance. Will convert to proper sheet if >5 pilots land in same week.

End of doc.
